claims.claim: Only the ingress caller forwards AIOS_ORIGIN_ADMISSION_KEY explicitly. No secrets inheritance or secret propagation to the other three carrier jobs was added.

Reusable ingress declares exactly AIOS_ORIGIN_ADMISSION_KEY as a required workflow_call secret. Its existing title gates, scoped permissions, self-hosted provenance gate and hosted delivery behavior remain unchanged.
Both origin_provenance and deliver retain deployment-owned secret references and existing fail-closed origin admission and authenticated receipt handling. No bypass or success branch was introduced.

Regression assertions distinguish ingress secret wiring from the three secret-free carriers and preserve exact-title routing, bounded permissions, native event identity and secret-exposure restrictions.

Focused mutation coverage asserts rejection of missing or renamed caller and callee secrets, inherited or additional caller secrets, and optional or additional callee secrets. Ingress-specific expectations retain unrelated carrier assertions.
The commit changes only the four authorized files. TASK-324, roadmap NEXT and the separate legacy and origin-affine authoring logic remain unchanged.
